description.p: Mugenkai is a Linux-first terminal designed around AI coding agents and web3 workflows. It embeds ghostty's terminal core for VT parsing and escape sequence handling, draws cells through a custom Rust glyph renderer on GTK4 + libadwaita, and routes AI orchestration to a sidecar daemon over a Unix-socket JSON-RPC protocol.
Mugenkai reads your existing ghostty config file, so your themes, fonts, colors, and keybindings carry over unchanged.
Development milestone: Phase 1 GTK4 host shell.
